cases.query: Which printer did I choose, why, and what about that reason needs checking now?

sources.label: Printer choice and wireless convenience
sources.text: I chose the Marigold printer because I was told it prints wirelessly.

sources.label: Connection requirements
sources.text: The Marigold manual says printing requires a USB cable. I have not changed my printer choice yet.

sources.label: Paper supplies
sources.text: I keep spare paper in the blue cupboard.

evaluation.reason: Retain the decision, its original reason and the later challenge without inventing a replacement.

cases.query: 我決定用哪個錄音工具，原本看中什麼，現在需要重新確認什麼？

sources.label: 錄音工具選擇
sources.text: 我決定用白鷺錄音，因為以為它能在沒有網路時自動備份。

sources.label: 備份條件
sources.text: 實測白鷺錄音的自動備份必須連上網路。我還沒有決定換工具。

sources.label: 麥克風位置
sources.text: 我的麥克風放在書桌右邊。

evaluation.reason: Both the original offline-backup assumption and corrected condition matter; no tool switch was adopted.

cases.query: What changed about Nia's planner reason, and did my own planner choice change?

sources.label: Nia's planner
sources.text: Nia chose Tansy Planner because she thought it could share calendars without an account.

sources.label: My planner
sources.text: I chose Violet Planner for its large print.

sources.label: Sharing rules and my decision
sources.text: Nia found Tansy requires an account to share calendars. I am still using Violet Planner for its large print.

evaluation.reason: Attribute the challenged reason to Nia, preserve the user's separate continuing choice.

cases.query: What is my normal way to work, and how is Tuesday different?

sources.label: Usual travel
sources.text: I normally walk to work because it is close.

sources.label: Tuesday exception
sources.text: This Tuesday only I will ride the bus while carrying equipment. That does not change my normal walking routine.

sources.label: Weekend sport
sources.text: I play badminton on Saturday.

evaluation.reason: A dated exception coexists with the normal routine.

cases.query: Have I committed to the teaching course, and what were the actual stages of my thinking?

sources.label: Possible course
sources.text: You could consider the evening teaching course.

sources.label: Initial reaction
sources.text: I might try that course, but I have not enrolled or decided.

sources.label: Later reflection
sources.text: After a better day at work I feel more confident, but I still have not decided about the teaching course.

evaluation.reason: Suggestion and changing feelings do not imply commitment; query explicitly asks for the stages.

cases.query: Why did I select Larch Storage, which reason changed, and which still holds?

sources.label: Storage selection
sources.text: I chose Larch Storage because it cost 6 credits monthly and supported local encryption.

sources.label: Subscription update
sources.text: Larch now costs 19 credits monthly; local encryption still works. I have not selected a replacement.

sources.label: Unrelated trip cost
sources.text: My last train ride cost 19 credits.

evaluation.reason: Only the price reason changes; local encryption continues. Shared price vocabulary is irrelevant.

cases.query: Why did I choose the Iris lamp and what did the later test show?

sources.label: Lamp choice
sources.text: I chose the Iris lamp because its brightness can be adjusted.

sources.label: Lamp test
sources.text: I tested the Iris lamp today and its brightness control works well. This confirms my original reason.

sources.label: Desk dimensions
sources.text: My desk is 110 centimetres wide.

evaluation.reason: Compatible confirmation should not be treated as a contradiction.

cases.query: Which telescope did I finally buy and why?

sources.label: Snacks
sources.text: I like sliced pears.

sources.label: Music
sources.text: I listen to piano music while cooking.

evaluation.reason: No telescope decision or reason is present; all returned sources would be irrelevant.
